problem_text:
A supply chain manager needs to allocate production capacity among 15 product lines to maximize total expected profit.  
The characteristics of each product line are as follows:  
* Product A: expected profit margin is 0.124, resource intensity is 0.288, capacity bounds [0.033, 0.408]  
* Product B: expected profit margin is 0.023, resource intensity is 0.062, capacity bounds [0.012, 0.899]  
* Product C: expected profit margin is 0.059, resource intensity is 0.113, capacity bounds [0.028, 0.595]  
* Product D: expected profit margin is 0.054, resource intensity is 0.120, capacity bounds [0.060, 0.363]  
* Product E: expected profit margin is 0.071, resource intensity is 0.072, capacity bounds [0.031, 0.563]  
* Product F: expected profit margin is 0.182, resource intensity is 0.076, capacity bounds [0.098, 0.695]  
* Product G: expected profit margin is 0.117, resource intensity is 0.043, capacity bounds [0.044, 0.351]  
* Product H: expected profit margin is 0.195, resource intensity is 0.296, capacity bounds [0.055, 0.386]  
* Product I: expected profit margin is 0.038, resource intensity is 0.046, capacity bounds [0.029, 0.540]  
* Product J: expected profit margin is 0.059, resource intensity is 0.042, capacity bounds [0.086, 0.654]  
* Product K: expected profit margin is 0.111, resource intensity is 0.049, capacity bounds [0.019, 0.361]  
* Product L: expected profit margin is 0.147, resource intensity is 0.231, capacity bounds [0.007, 0.855]  
* Product M: expected profit margin is 0.086, resource intensity is 0.214, capacity bounds [0.084, 0.887]  
* Product N: expected profit margin is 0.126, resource intensity is 0.172, capacity bounds [0.048, 0.339]  
* Product O: expected profit margin is 0.099, resource intensity is 0.022, capacity bounds [0.068, 0.885]  

Each product line must receive a proportion of total production capacity within its specified bounds, and all capacity allocations must sum to one. To maintain operational flexibility, the manager requires that the group of fast-moving products, represented by the subset F = {B, C, E, H, I, J, O}, collectively receive at least 0.309 of the total capacity. Additionally, the overall resource consumption index must not exceed 0.157, and the total expected profit margin must be no less than 0.081. Determine the optimal capacity allocation that maximizes total expected profit while satisfying all constraints.
